summary: Master the art of retail management with our specialized training course. Gain essential skills to drive sales and elevate your team's performance.
lede: Retail management links commercial planning with store operations for professionals responsible for merchandise, teams, and customer experience. The course develops practical skills in reading point-of-sale data, managing assortments and replenishment, and planning store audits and workforce deployment to support consistent service and stock control.
audienceIntro: Retail management professionals who influence merchandise, store, customer, workforce, or omnichannel performance will find the course relevant. It suits experienced practitioners who want stronger analytical discipline and leaders who need a practical operating framework for retail execution.
modules: Retail Strategy, Reporting, and Improvement Roadmap
prerequisites: You should have practical experience in retail stores, merchandising, inventory, customer experience, retail planning, or omnichannel fulfilment. Familiarity with sales reports, inventory terminology, and store KPIs will help you gain more from the exercises. No programming is required. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted demand forecasting, RFID visibility, and automated replenishment are addressed at conceptual and operational application level, while POS analysis, scorecards, audits, and action plans receive hands-on practice.
